name: Parth Sarthi
role: Data Architect · Platform Modernisation · Technical & Delivery Leadership

projects.name: iDiscover
projects.title: A foundation that serves more than one business.
projects.summary: An enterprise data platform connecting pharmaceutical, commercial and supply chain needs through a shared architecture.
projects.problem: Pharmaceutical, commercial, and supply chain teams needed an enterprise data foundation spanning ingestion, warehousing, and downstream distribution.
projects.ownership: Primary solution architect, from initial design through platform evolution and delivery.
decisions: Designed reusable, restartable, metadata-driven ETL patterns to support scalable onboarding.
Architected AWS pipelines orchestrated through Airflow, with Redshift and PostgreSQL warehouse models.
Integrated SPyDr source-to-target testing with JIRA evidence capture and established CI/CD and regression processes.
Replaced access-key-based access with IAM role-based authentication and optimised EMR configurations for workload needs.
projects.execution: Worked directly with Singapore stakeholders, including during a 2018 business visit, to shape iDiscover and OTIF solutioning. Translated requirements into epics and user stories, with Agile/Scrum delivery and governance of data quality and SLA adherence.
projects.outcome: Established the enterprise foundation used by iDiscover and the AnGen analytics layer. Reusable patterns reduced onboarding effort; workload optimisation improved infrastructure utilisation.

projects.name: Platform modernisation
projects.category: From legacy ETL to managed platforms
projects.title: Modernisation is a sequence of decisions.
projects.summary: 1,000+ Talend jobs migrated to AWS / Airflow. Now supporting the next stage of iDiscover’s evolution toward Databricks.
projects.role: Migration lead; contributor to ongoing Databricks modernisation
projects.status: AWS / Airflow complete · Databricks in progress
projects.metricLabel: Talend ETL jobs migrated to AWS / Airflow
projects.problem: A large Talend ETL estate needed more maintainable orchestration and reusable cloud engineering patterns.
projects.ownership: Led the migration of 1,000+ Talend jobs to an AWS-based Airflow framework. Currently supporting the next stage of iDiscover modernisation toward Databricks.
decisions: Moved legacy ETL workloads into an AWS-based Apache Airflow framework.
Established reusable pipeline patterns and engineering standards for production workloads.
Supported team capability through mentoring and code reviews.
Now supporting the migration of orchestration and processing toward managed Databricks capabilities.
projects.execution: Combined ETL leadership, complex SQL development and warehouse modelling with cloud-framework delivery. The next platform phase is an ongoing contribution rather than a completed migration claim.
projects.outcome: Completed migration of 1,000+ ETL jobs to AWS / Airflow. The subsequent Databricks initiative is in progress; no completion or performance claims are made for that phase.

projects.name: AnGen
projects.title: A common language for business performance.
projects.summary: 10+ governed data marts connecting commercial and medical data to consistent KPIs and Tableau reporting.
projects.metricLabel: governed data marts forming the Tableau semantic layer
projects.problem: Commercial and medical analytics required consistent business definitions across markets and reporting use cases.
projects.ownership: Architect for the analytics layer on iDiscover, and primary technical contact for platform architecture, data quality, and delivery.
decisions: Built 10+ governed data marts as the semantic layer for Tableau reporting.
Standardised business logic and metric definitions for commercial sales and market-performance KPIs.
Modelled Medical Science Liaison interactions with healthcare professionals, including communication modes and coverage.
Governed master-data mappings, data quality, and pipeline reliability across the two platforms.
projects.execution: Connected stakeholder needs with data models, aggregation strategies and semantic delivery. Governed mappings across Product, Therapeutic Area, Disease Area and related reference domains.
projects.outcome: Enabled commercial and medical analytics through a governed semantic layer, with 10+ data marts supporting consistent downstream reporting.
flow: 10+ governed data marts · Shared KPI definitions
Tableau · Sales, market and medical-field analytics

projects.name: OTIF
projects.title: The engineering inside “on time”.
projects.summary: Calendar-aware pipelines for On Time In Full delivery measurement.
projects.problem: On Time In Full reporting depends on an expected delivery date that reflects actual operational calendars.
projects.ownership: Data engineering and delivery-date processing logic for the supply chain OTIF solution.
decisions: Incorporated warehouse holidays, public holidays, transit time, and delivery-calendar dependencies into expected-date calculations.
Transformed operational and logistics data into analytics-ready datasets.
Created pipelines to calculate and track On Time In Full metrics.
projects.execution: Contributed to stakeholder solutioning during the 2018 Singapore business visit and delivered the OTIF data-engineering work in 2019.
projects.outcome: Enabled OTIF reporting using calendar-aware delivery calculations. Business improvement percentages and the reporting scale remain to be documented.
flow: Warehouse holidays · Public holidays · Transit time

milestones: Joined TCS in December, following a B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at SJBIT, VTU.
Digital Cadre designation in February 2019; promoted to IT Analyst in February 2020.
Deputed onsite to Johnson & Johnson in April, working directly with business stakeholders.
Promoted to Assistant Consultant in November 2023; ongoing platform architecture and portfolio leadership.
